resources.string: This isn\'t a Strilka stations file
App info → Battery → “Unrestricted”. And in Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → add “Strilka” to never sleeping apps.
If Android asks, allow installs from “Strilka”. Your stations and settings will be kept.
App info → Autostart — turn on. Then Battery saver → “No restrictions”. In Recent apps, pull Strilka down and lock it.
Settings → Battery → App launch → Strilka: turn off “Manage automatically” and turn on all three switches (auto-launch, secondary launch, run in background).
Settings → Battery → High background power consumption → turn on for Strilka. And in i Manager → Autostart — turn on.
